name: Architecture catalog solution
description: Host-free microservices workspace. Caller must provide a PascalCase name, namespace and nonexistent output directory. See the catalog preflight; never use --force.

composition.description: Explicit system composition. Only microservices is implemented in 0.2.0.

choices.description: Independently deployed services; no system-wide host.

rootNamespace.description: C# namespace prefix with PascalCase segments, e.g. Acme.Commerce. Caller validates before generation.
